data.name: Order confirmation and status
data.description:
Web Application Server sends an order confirmation and status update back to 
the Customer.

data.name: Record order details
data.description:
If payment is successful, the Web Application Server records the new order details 
and payment status in the MongoDB Database.

data.name: Customer submit order
data.description: Customer selects items, customizes them, and submits the order details to the Web Application Server.

data.name: Backend sends payment request
data.description:
Web Application Server initiates a payment request, sending tokenized payment 
information to the Payment Gateway (a Third-Party Service).

data.name: Transaction Response
data.description:
Payment Gateway processes the payment and sends a transaction response 
(success/failure) back to the Web Application Server

data.name: Send order list
data.description: Web Application Server sends the order list to the Barista for display.

data.name: Query order data
data.description:
Web Application Server authenticates and authorizes the Barista, then queries 
the MongoDB Database for relevant order data.

data.name: View incoming orders
data.description:
Barista logs into the staff interface and requests to view incoming orders from the 
Web Application Server.

data.name: Send updated order status
data.description: Barista sends the updated order status to the Web Application Server

data.name: Send pending order data
data.description:
MongoDB Database retrieves the pending order data and sends it to the Web 
Application Server.

data.name: Update order record
data.description:
Web Application Server validates the status update and updates the order record 
in the MongoDB Database.
